request_original_sha256.input: complete immutable request file raw bytes B, including actual whitespace and final newline if any
request_original_sha256.storage: F1 external manifest and commit gate/receipt; never self-field inside request

strict_json_parse.float_numbers: reject; integer fields only, bool is not integer
strict_json_parse.unicode: no normalization; unpaired surrogates rejected by strict UTF-8 encoding
strict_json_parse.unknown_or_unfilled_final_fields: reject by frozen schema; no placeholders/nulls in final intent

exception_intent_sha256.input: entire parsed final request object I, every top-level and nested schema field including baseline/approval/script/setup/operations/protected/governance

ordinary_native_intent_sha256.scope: ordinary setup/progress/completed only; unchanged source algorithm
ordinary_native_intent_sha256.canonicalizer: original registry_transaction.canonical then UTF-8 then SHA256

explicit_exception_digest_difference: B digest includes the complete final intent/baseline, unlike native ordinary intent. This hash-producer difference is an explicit part of the one-time authorization, not a change to source tools, registry6-field shape or global schema/semantics values.
cross_field_checks: baseline.revision equals setup_receipt.post_setup_revision and actual confirmed native started after revision
baseline.sha256 equals setup_receipt.post_setup_sha256, native started actual after file and locked current complete README
setup native request raw hash and ordinary intent hash recomputed, actual event/owner/empty grants/own row and return verified; idempotent/current hash alone not sufficient
all referenced input files real local nonlinked under approved scope, exact raw hashes and existing real approval/capability/fresh governance verified
operations equal exact two approved transforms; all old events/owners/14 business rows and target hash preserved
raw request hash AND exception intent hash must match F1/gate independently; same intent does not permit reformatting frozen original
transaction ID unused; event ID is REG-TXN- plus exactly that ID; base_sha256 is actual locked baseline.sha256; new revision is actual baseline.revision+1
candidate prepared outside source has truthful preparation timestamp, pending postwrite verification; under native lock reproduction must equal frozen candidate full bytes/hash, no nested apply
exception request top shape cannot carry its own raw hash/intent digest/final after README hash/gate or postcommit receipt hash; upstream refs cannot depend on downstream hashes

freeze_phases.source_action: ordinary started only after exact B_SETUP grant
freeze: actual script/template/native-tool identities and bounded materialization rule
complete native setup request raw+native intent hashes and pre-setup baseline
planned commit mode and exact scope
must_not_require: future final exception request or its hashes
freeze_phases.authority: external authorization binds F0 after F0 frozen; F0 does not include that future authorization hash

requires: confirmed native setup and exact only-own setup delta
fresh actual post-setup complete baseline and owner/empty grants
schema-valid final exception request, both digests
full private candidate bytes/diff/hash and protection proof; native candidate checks
freeze_phases.authority: one explicit B authorization may cover setup plus conditional commit, pinned F0/script/template/rule; absent explicit conditional coverage requires separate exact final commit approval

freeze_phases.source_action: at most one exceptional atomic structure+correction+metadata commit
requires: external gate binds frozen F1 exact raw request/intent/candidate/diff/baseline and actual authority
re-read and independently recompute both digests and all source/approval/script identities
under original registry lock verify/reproduce exact frozen candidate bytes from locked original, then fsync/atomic replace/readback
never: treat unrelated drift as own setup
wait for approval holding source lock
retry after failed/unknown outcome or silently replace transaction ID

freeze_phases.source_action: ordinary own progress/completed only on actual verified outcome under B lifecycle scope
requires: separate truthful exception receipt with actual before/after hashes and lock/replace/readback outcome
fresh source full governance0 and strict unique selector/row/history checks
freeze_phases.unknown: read only reconcile existing attempt; no inferred success, rollback overwrite or automatic retry

acyclic_order: R3 bundle -> actual mechanism/template/setup request -> F0 manifest -> pre-setup authorization -> native setup proof

post-setup preservation/governance inputs plus earlier objects -> final request -> raw+intent digests -> private candidate/diff -> F1 manifest -> external commit gate/optional final approval -> actual exception receipt
cycle_rule: No upstream artifact may contain the final digest of a downstream artifact; file paths/IDs may be fixed in advance, future hashes/actual outcomes must not be invented.

namespace_rule.pre_setup: README must already exist as exact real local source; task/transaction IDs and future exclusive artifact names unused
namespace_rule.post_setup: own started row/evidence namespace must exist with same owner/empty grants and pinned hashes; read verified own files or create distinct new evidence files exclusively
namespace_rule.commit: same existing source must match final baseline; exception transaction/event ID unused; foreign/unknown occupancy, links or drift stop
namespace_rule.postcommit: existing transaction is reconciled read-only, never treated as a new commit opportunity
